how: We read the website of every Orlando wedding florist listed on Lazo (139 listings, 113 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: floral preservation services and a preservation drop-off, same-day delivery and gift shops, a rose-box retailer, an interior landscaping company, a venue, and a wedding planner. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you keep blooms fresh through Florida heat and humidity, especially for an outdoor ceremony?
Do you design and install at the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are where the price moves.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: Sweet Juliet Designs Floral & Decor
picks.blurb: Sweet Juliet Designs is the wedding and event branch of Apopka Florist, bringing over 47 years of floral experience to wedding work tailored to your vision and budget. Consultations are offered to Apopka and Orlando couples.

picks.name: Raining Roses Productions
picks.blurb: Jesus Rodriguez and Jonathan Panczuk founded Raining Roses in 2001, bringing a fashion background and 20 years in the floral industry. The Orlando studio produces event design, florals, drape and decor for wedding and corporate clients.

picks.name: Lavender & Lace Wedding Floral Design
picks.blurb: Lavender & Lace specializes in weddings, with Stephanie designing pre-set packages that can be fully customized to each couple. Based in Howey-in-the-Hills and serving all of Central Florida, pitched as high quality and affordable.

picks.name: Bluegrass Chic | Orlando Wedding Florist
picks.blurb: The owner of Bluegrass Chic was an EMT and part-time firefighter before floral design, and says showing up for people in moments that matter is the same calling. The studio is featured in Orlando City Magazine's 2026 Best of Weddings and makes Southern hospitality its line.

picks.name: TFW DESIGN
picks.blurb: TFW Design came out of a shared architecture and interior design background and an idea formed in 2020, spending two years learning the medium from the ground up. Floral design, creative direction and production for large-scale weddings, shaped in house in Orlando.

picks.name: Yayas Bloom Floristry of Orlando
picks.blurb: Yaya is the creative force behind Yaya's Bloom Floristry in Orlando, specializing in luxury wedding florals with bold textures and unexpected color palettes. Custom, one-of-a-kind arrangements, with retail and corporate work on the side.

picks.name: The Bloomerati
picks.blurb: Angelica Munoz of The Bloomerati brings 20 years in the wedding and event industry, from bridal styling to beauty work alongside designer Pnina Tornai. Show-stopping installations and tablescapes, plus a rental collection of flower walls and statement decor.

picks.name: Le Fleur Atelier
picks.blurb: Le Fleur Atelier in Mount Dora is a boutique floral studio for curated, luxury wedding and corporate event florals. Every arrangement is designed for the specific client, refined and organic, with a personalized process from consultation through installation.

picks.name: Lee Forrest Design LLC
picks.blurb: Lee Forrest Design is a floral design boutique on Bumby Avenue in Orlando's Milk District, with a look it describes as clean and modern with traditional inspiration. Custom weddings, from opulent European garden styles to dramatic tropical arrangements.

picks.name: BAUGhaus
picks.blurb: BAUGhaus is a floral design studio in Eustis built on intentional design, with an emphasis on modern and organic arrangements for couples who want to stray from traditional event florals. The name is a play on the owner's married name and the Bauhaus art school.

picks.name: The Flower Studio Altamonte
picks.blurb: San Smith leads The Flower Studio Altamonte, designing wedding and event florals across Central Florida. She began as a freelancer, joined the studio during COVID and acquired the business in 2023, with over seven years of experience and continuing study at Floriology Institute.

picks.name: No. 1 Flowers
picks.blurb: No. 1 Flowers by Jo in Windermere specializes in weddings, events and installations, and also teaches: a two-day floral mastery workshop, one-on-one intensives and wedding floral business mentorship are on the site alongside the design work.
